description:
Satoru-kun
Satoru-kun is a guy who has a strange power, that he can read people's minds even he did not expect that the most cute and most beautiful woman in his class expressed her love to Satoru-kun when Satoru-kun intends to invite to study together at his house . And when they start having sex, Satoru-kun's powers can read what thoughts his girlfriend wants and get them to the level of further romantic relationships.

(Source: Nekopoi, translated and edited)
